source: Author requested a fur armor family matching the existing separate-piece armor families, October 15, 2026. Docs/WORLD_BASIS.md controls fur scarcity and no-cloth construction.
scope: Five individual catalog entries. No aggregate suit, executable recipes, numerical protection, set bonus, new equipment slots, world placement, generated identities, streaming or persisted runtime changes.

defaults.Carrier metadata: Booter-worn armor concept; fitting, packing and spare-cargo rules unresolved.
defaults.Acquisition: Proposed furworking or specialist trade; sourcing, availability and recipe unresolved.
defaults.Crafting / processing: One separately fitted piece made from prepared fur-bearing panels. Fur processing has extremely low usable yield; no ordinary cloth backing, preparation recipe, quantities, yield or production time established.
defaults.Limitations: Fit, coverage, fastening, articulation, mass, durability, thermal behavior and protection remain proposals. Fur does not grant electrical insulation, storm immunity, set bonuses or additional equipment slots. No ordinary cloth or abundant processed fur supply assumed.
defaults.Classification basis: One independently listed piece in the author-requested fur armor family. Paired guards and boots are one named catalog item per coverage group, matching the existing armor families. No whole-set inventory item.
defaults.Tier basis: Proposed T2 finished piece using qualified T1 fur stock; fur qualification, processing and construction remain unresolved. Tier does not establish protection or rarity.
